reasons.refund_claim_supported: Carrier shows delivery by a neighbour but signature unmatched and GPS 140m away, so evidence is genuinely mixed with a slight tilt against the claim.
reasons.claim_handling: A carrier trace is the most defensible step, with holding the refund until the trace concludes as the next most likely handling.
reasons.fraud_risk: Unmatched signer, off-address GPS, recent move and two prior no-investigation refunds lean slightly toward not genuine without proving fraud.
